items.title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
items.summary: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.

items.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends

items.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
items.summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.
